scope: Open meta-analysis of randomised trials of bronchial artery embolization for haemoptysis, including studies of massive haemoptysis.

keyRecommendations.text: Compared with pharmacotherapy, BAE had higher clinical efficacy (RR 1.24), lower recurrence (RR 0.26), lower mortality (RR 0.20), and fewer overall complications (RR 0.41), each with moderate-certainty evidence.
Sixteen of the included studies involved massive haemoptysis.

clinicalBottomLine: In this meta-analysis of trials, bronchial artery embolization beat pharmacotherapy on efficacy, recurrence, mortality, and complications. It is outcome evidence, not a full airway-bleeding algorithm.
notableCaveats: A narrative review of the ABC approach to massive haemoptysis was not available as open full text. These questions stay inside the meta-analysis.

source.title: Efficacy and safety of bronchial artery embolization in the treatment of hemoptysis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs.
